programme.title: A Dandy in Aspic
programme.desc: 1968. Thriller. Directed by Anthony Mann. Stars Mia Farrow, Laurence Harvey, Tom Courtenay. British Intelligence orders its operatives to eliminate a Soviet spy, unaware he's one of their own men.

programme.title: Nor the Moon By Night
programme.desc: 1958. Adventure. Director: Ken Annakin. Stars Michael Craig, Belinda Lee, Patrick McGoohan. After a the loss of her mother, a young women sets out to find her African pen pal.

programme.title: Three Came Home
programme.desc: 1950. True story of a woman imprisoned in several Japanese war camps. She struggles to protect her young son. Stars Claudette Colbert.

programme.title: Thunder Rock
programme.desc: 1942. Supernatural drama starring Michael Redgrave, Barbara Mullen & James Mason. One of The Boulting Brothers' finest, a disillusioned writer becomes a lighthouse keeper living in solitude.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: Rich Man's Son. 1955. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Lee Erickson & Don Haggerty. The son of a railway executive runs away to become a gun toting ranch hand, but Wyatt teaches him some important lessons.

programme.title: The Last Journey (1935)
programme.desc: 1935. Drama. Director: Bernard Vorhaus. Bob (Julien Mitchell) is distraught with his upcoming forced retirement and believes his wife is having an affair. The day arrives for his final journey.

programme.title: The Large Rope
programme.desc: (AKA: The Long Rope). 1953. Drama. Director: Wolf Rilla. Stars Donald Houston, Susan Shaw & Peter Byrne. A man returns to where he was accused of murdering a girl to prove his innocence.

programme.title: D.O.A. (1949)
programme.desc: 1949. Mystery. Directed by Rudolph Maté. Stars Edmond O'Brien, Pamela Britton & Luther Adler. An accountant learns that he has been poisoned, with only a few days to live, he hunts down his enemy.

programme.title: Miss Robin Hood
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Henry is a mild man who writes adventure stories for his girls. All is fine until he meets Miss Honey! Starring Richard Hearne & Margaret Rutherford. Directed by John Guillermin.

programme.title: Doctor In Clover
programme.desc: 1966. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars James Robertson Justice, Leslie Phillips, Shirley Anne Field. Gaston Grimsdyke enrols on a medical course run by Sir Lancelot Spratt.

programme.title: Lorna Doone
programme.desc: 1951. Adventure. Directed by Phil Karlson. Stars Barbara Hale, Richard Greene & Carl Benton Reid. A love affair between a farmer and an outlaw's daughter develops with bitter-sweet results.

programme.title: A Matter of Choice
programme.desc: 1963. Crime Drama. Director: Vernon Sewell. Stars Anthony Steel, Jeanne Moody & Ballard Berkeley. 2 youths accidentally cause a man's death and inadvertently reveal his liaison with a married woman.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: Downfall. 1964. Directed by John Llewellyn Moxey. Stars Maurice Denham, Nadja Regin & T.P. McKenna. Harold Crossley is a barrister and respected intellectual, but is no match to his scheming wife.

programme.title: Star Performance: Dante's Inferno
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Directed by Robert Florey. Stars Dick Powell, Virginia Grey & Regis Toomey. At Willie Dante's bar, a woman confides in him about her husband threatening her - then she turns up dead.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Marsha, Queen of Diamonds. 1966. Stars Adam West, Carolyn Jones & Estelle Winwood. Batman and Robin attempt to foil Marsha, Queen of Diamonds' plan to steal the Batcomputer's power source.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Rolling Racketeers. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Bruno Barnabe & Bill Edwards. Maguire disguises himself as a tramp to track down an organised gang of car thieves operating in Hertfordshire.

programme.title: California Suite
programme.desc: 1978. Comedy. Directed by Herbert Ross. Stars Jane Fonda, Maggie Smith & Michael Caine. The misadventures and struggles of four sets of guests staying at the luxury Beverly Hills Hotel.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline welcomes you back to the cellar and an evening peppered with terror. This week we go back to the 70s and begin with the 1978 cult classic The Eyes of Laura Mars starring Faye Dunaway.

programme.title: The Eyes of Laura Mars
programme.desc: 1978. Horror/Thriller. Director: Irvin Kershner. Stars Faye Dunaway, Tommy Lee Jones & Raul Julia. A fashion photographer develops a disturbing ability to see through the eyes of a serial killer.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: We return to the topic of sight with the next offering - Mansion of the Doomed. Caroline Munro presents the 1976 horror starring Hollywood greats Richard Basehart and Gloria Grahame.

programme.title: Mansion of the Doomed
programme.desc: 1976. Horror. Directed by Michael Pataki. Stars Richard Basehart, Gloria Grahame & Trish Stewart. An insane surgeon attempts to restore his daughter's eyesight after she is blinded in an accident.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Before Caroline locks up for the night, she allows us to take a peek at next week's thrilling films from top directors.

programme.title: Voyage to the Planet of Prehistoric Women
programme.desc: 1968. Sci-fi. Director: Peter Bogdanovich. Stars Mamie Van Doren & Mary Marr. When a group of astronauts land on Venus they are surprised to find dangerous creatures and beautiful women.

programme.title: The Big Boodle
programme.desc: 1957. Crime. Directed by Richard Wilson. Stars Errol Flynn, Pedro Armendáriz & Rossana Rory. Cuban crooks and police chase a casino card dealer who is falsely accused of counterfeiting pesos.

programme.title: Charlie Chester Don't Take Chances
programme.desc: The 1940s tale of Billy Bart, a comedic rhyming poem about pedestrian safety and the rules of crossing the road.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts in Court. 1963. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Kathleen Freeman & Murvyn Vye. When a couple who ran into the Clampett's car discover that they're rich, they decide to fake injuries and sue them.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: Songs My Mother Taught Me. Western with Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray, who run a stagecoach line in the Old West where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Master Spy
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Directed By Montgomery Tully. Starring Stephen Murray. A Russian scientist working for the British is suspected of being a 'plant', sent to monitor nuclear secrets for the Communists.

programme.title: Look At Life Smashing Through
programme.desc: 1959. A look at the exciting world of stock car racing, with glimpses at all the bumps and smashes, and thrills and spills that make up the amazing sport.

programme.title: You Pay Your Money
programme.desc: 1957. Crime Drama. A rogue smuggler enters a murky world when his wife is kidnapped. Directed by Maclean Rogers. Starring Hugh McDermott, Jane Hylton and Honor Blackman.

programme.title: The Return of October
programme.desc: 1948. Comedy. Director: Joseph H. Lewis. Stars Glenn Ford, Terry Moore & Albert Sharpe. A young woman must prove her sanity after claiming that a racehorse is the reincarnation of her late uncle.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: 1966. Action. Directed by Leslie Martinson. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Lee Meriwether. Catwoman, the Joker, the Penguin and the Riddler join forces to dispose of Batman and Robin.

programme.title: Islington Road Safety 1940s
programme.desc: A 1940s short film issued by the Islington Road Safety Committee about the importance of taking precautions when using the road, the lack of road safety and the rise in dangers for pedestrians.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Judas Sheep. 1975. Stars Jennifer Wilson, Jack Watson & Michael Elwyn. Jennifer and Edward decide to adopt but soon run into difficulties. Bill runs into serious conflict with Don and Jane.

programme.title: The Four Feathers (1939)
programme.desc: 1939. Adventure. Director: Zoltan Korda. Stars John Clements, Ralph Richardson & C. Aubrey Smith. A British officer seeks to redeem his cowardice 'feathers' by secretly aiding his former comrades.

programme.title: Mr. Beamish Goes South
programme.desc: 1953. Mystery. Directed by Oscar Burn & John Wall. Stars John Laurie & Hector Ross. An amateur detective pursues a seaside serial killer who disposes of his female victims in an acid bath.

programme.title: Douglas Fairbanks Presents
programme.desc: The Relative Truth. 1954. Stars Patrick Holt & Liam Redmond. The smell of gas forces neighbours to break into a room but the couple have vanished. After questioning, nobody's stories fit together.

programme.title: Strange But True
programme.desc: Etta Smith. 1995. Michael Aspel delves into another fascinating and extraordinary story - how Etta Smith succeeded where the Los Angeles Police Department failed with her psychic powers.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Butterfly Winter. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Kenneth Cranham & Geraldine Gardner. Ash and the men of 347 Section tackle Hitler's latest deadly invention, the butterfly bomb.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: A Man of No Importance. Stars Barry Foster, Michael Latimer & Susan Travers. When a dead man turns up on the deck of a canal barge, everyone is ready to dismiss him as a nonentity.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: A Shadow in the Courtyard. 2004. Stars Bruno Cremer, Christine Boisson & Alain Rimoux. Mr Boyer has been murdered and more than 300,000 Francs stolen. Maigret tries to piece the puzzle together.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: Episode 4. 1997. Stars Robson Green, Michael Kitchen & Daniela Nardini. As Owen and Anna's relationship develops, Anna's husband hires a private detective to find out who she's been seeing.

programme.title: The Claim
programme.desc: 2000. Romance. Director: Michael Winterbottom. Stars Peter Mullan, Milla Jovovich & Wes Bentley. A man who sold his wife and daughter to get ahead in business has his past come back to haunt him.

programme.title: Planespotting
programme.desc: 2005. Drama. Director: Christopher Menaul. Stars Lesley Sharp, Mark Benton & Ross Boatman. A group of aircraft enthusiasts are wrongly convicted of spying during a plane spotting trip to Greece.

programme.title: Circumstantial Evidence (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Director: Daniel Birt. Stars: Rona Anderson, Patrick Holt & John Arnatt. Cleverly crafted crime drama - A woman seeks evidence that will give her grounds for divorce.

programme.title: Churchill's Secret Army
programme.desc: Secret Sweeties. 2003. A look at the women who joined the Secret British Resistance Units and their part in the D-Day deception that fooled Hitler into thinking that the Allies would strike back.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Unlucky Gambler. 1955. Stars Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Richard O' Sullivan. Holmes and the team delve into the seedy gambling underworld to find a young boy's father.

programme.title: Melody Club
programme.desc: 1949. Comedy. A nitwit investigator (Terry Thomas) goes undercover in a restaurant to catch a gang of crooks.

programme.title: The Happiness of Three Women
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. Director: Maurice Elvey. Stars Petula Clark, Donald Houston & Brenda de Banzie. Story of a Welsh postman's efforts to bring happiness into the lives of an assortment of people.

programme.title: Card from the Cotswolds
programme.desc: 1948. A day in the life of a farmer in the Cotswolds. Watch as he tends to his farm, looks after his animals and spends time in the local area.

programme.title: The Price of Silence
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: Montgomery Tully. Stars Gordon Jackson, June Thorburn & Mary Clare. Roger forges a new life for himself after his release from prison. But his past catches up with him.

programme.title: Nearest and Dearest
programme.desc: 1972. Comedy. Directed by John Robins. Stars Hylda Baker, Jimmy Jewel & Edward Malin. After their father's death, two siblings inherit a decrepit pickle factory and attempt to keep it afloat.

programme.title: Sparrows Can't Sing
programme.desc: 1963. Comedy. Director: Joan Littlewood. Stars James Booth, Barbara Windsor & Roy Kinnear. Charlie returns to the East End after two years at sea to find his house demolished and wife Maggie gone.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: My Old Man's a Dustman - Part 1. 1973. Stars Richard Wilson & Ann Firbank. Martha and Albert Cousins and Michael Mayes are accused of dumping thousands of gallons of toxic waste into a quarry.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: My Old Man's a Dustman - Part 2. 1973. Stars Paddy Joyce, Tommy Godfrey & Hilda Fenemore. Mr. Justice Craig calls Severn Quarry gate man Bill to answer questions about the poisonous liquid waste.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: My Old Man's a Dustman - Part 3. 1973. Stars Donald Morley, Hilda Fenemore & John Flanagan. In the final day of court, the last claims are made by Martha Cousins and Michael Mayes.

programme.title: Doctor In Distress
programme.desc: 1963. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, James Robertson Justice & Samantha Eggar. Dr. Simon Sparrow's love life improves when the lovely Delia Mallory is brought into casualty.

programme.title: Tonight in Great Britain
programme.desc: 1955. A star studded short film featuring Tessie O'Shea, Eddie Gray and Max Bygraves at the London Palladium, Hattie Jacques at the Players' Theatre, Jean Carson at the Café de Paris and many more!

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: The Widower. 1970. Stars Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Ada brings Walter home for the first time, for a fish and chip supper. (S1, E01)

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Affair of the Heart. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Robert Ayres & Bruce Beeby. Peggy Miller gets £10,000 after her husband unexpectedly dies from a heart attack.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Windmills. 1976. Stars Jean Anderson, Patrick O'Connell & Richard Easton. Jennifer prepares for court while David tries to get close to Jane. Plus, a revelation about the flight crew unravels.

programme.title: East of Sudan
programme.desc: 1964. Adventure. Directed by Nathan Juran. Stars Anthony Quayle, Sylvia Sims & Derek Fowlds. Two colonial soldiers in 19th-century Africa risk their lives to save a governess and her charge.

programme.title: The Upturned Glass
programme.desc: 1946. Thriller. Director: Lawrence Huntington. Stars: James Mason, Rosamund John, Pamela Kellino. A leading brain surgeon believes himself responsible for the death of the woman he loves.
